entity: FDA premarket approval (PMA) changes for high-risk devices: share filed as 30-day notices, 2000-04 vs 2010 on
what_we_add: the 19% (2000-04) to 64% (2010 on) rise; Medtronic defibrillator line P980016 with 928 changes, 621 of them 30-day notices
why:
The only usable source (RAPS, 2023) says the 30-day notice is the most-used supplement type. That fits our 64% level, but it gives no window and no trend, so our rise can't be lined up.
The JAMA quotes (67.3% 30-day; 'increased markedly since 1997') would likely make this Matched, but they're blocked and not paywalled, so they're ignored. MedTech Dive is blocked too.
